text: 在近期的震荡行情中，资金逆势流入硬科技板块。测算显示，过去1个月来，科创50、半导体、通信、人工智能等相关主题ETF资金净流入超过500亿元。此外，近期科技主题基金密集成立，在新成立ETF披露的持有人名单中，频现产业资本和机构投资者的身影。(上证报)
text_en: Amid recent market volatility, capital has flowed into hard-tech sectors against the trend. Estimates show that over the past month, net inflows into ETFs related to the STAR 50, semiconductors, communications and artificial intelligence exceeded 50 billion yuan. In addition, technology-themed funds have been established intensively recently, and industrial capital and institutional investors have frequently appeared in the lists of holders disclosed by newly established ETFs. (Shanghai Securities News)
